- **Reading out the answer:** the output score for digit d is 2·d·D − d², which is highest when d equals the computed distance D. Non-digit tokens get a large negative score.

I changed the architecture in two ways: I removed LayerNorm so the numbers in the model stay exact, and I made the attention head size independent of the model width.
